changelog.title: Latest updates
changelog.companion_details: {LINK} is a Twitch extension allowing your viewers to play bingos, take part in quizzes or click on your stream.

highlights.d: A brand new Twitch extension made for Twitchat. Your viewers can now play Bingos, take part in Quizzes, click on your stream and even type on it, directly from Twitch, on desktop and mobile.

Create quizzes your viewers can play from the Twitchat Companion extension or from the chat.
  • 3 question types
  • All the options you could dream of
  • Import/export your questions as CSV
  • Live leaderboard
A /quickquiz command can also create an ephemeral single question quiz.

Create clickable areas and make them show up on the extension.

Add cooldowns or permissions to them.
Twitchat now connects with Meld Studio. Control it and react to what happens in it from the Triggers.

The Stream Deck plugin has been rewritten from scratch.
OBS-websocket is no longer required to use it.

Connect your Bluesky account to:
  • Post a message from the Triggers
  • Update your live status
  • Get notified about new followers
  • Receive your DMs and mentions right in Twitchat

You'll now be notified when you receive jewels on YouTube.

A dedicated trigger event is also available.
Define a prefix and/or a suffix that will automatically be added to your stream title anytime you update it from Twitchat.

Placeholders can now be transformed:
  • {USER.uppercase} => DURSS
  • {AMOUNT.currency(EUR)} => €12.50
  • {USER_FOLLOWAGE_MS.duration} => 1d 4h 12m 30s
Almost 70 modifiers are available to format text, numbers, dates, durations or lists. They work on the Triggers as well as on the Labels overlay. See the full list.
The "Optional command parameters" can now extract information in a much more precise way. Either by defining a message format, or from a regular expression.

Triggers can now have a custom icon to spot them at a glance in your list. Find your Triggers thanks to a new search field. New conditions interface. 16 new events:
  • Quiz complete
  • Custom Power Up redeemed
  • Jewels received on YouTube
  • User joins a raffle
  • Meld Studio: start/stop streaming, scene change, layer visibility, effect enabled and track mute
7 new actions:
  • Toggle clickable area
  • Edit a label
    • {_LI}
  • Ask for stream input
  • Post on Bluesky
  • Control Meld Studio
  • Change OBS filters settings
  • Change OBS sources audio tracks
Execute Twitchat actions from any external application with simple HTTP requests. Everything you can do with it is listed on the brand new API documentation.

Many other things have been added or modified.
Read complete changelog here

Although I recently accepted a job offer, Twitchat has been my main activity for almost 3 years without any other source of income.

If you can afford it, a one-time donation on PayPal or a monthly support on Patreon would be super appreciated ❤️
